doc: shift = clip(EARTH_ITCZ_SHIFT_X asym / EARTH_LAND_ASYMMETRY, +-0.35) x phi_H for the synthetic world (asymmetry 0.115 gives 0.096 of the Hadley edge, not clipped). Constants 5/30, 0.20 and 0.35 are read from the source. Only `land` is read. Float64: 1e-9. Output `shift_deg` is 0-d: shape [] in case.json, one item of data.bin. params.constants lists the module constants and the inline numbers the function reads (a port copies them from its own source and may assert that they equal these).
